title: 第25章 师尊的极道帝兜第26章 你身上有别的女人的味道
slug: 重生魔帝开局骗女帝下界双修
content_zh:
而另一边。
阴阳圣宗之内。
林云才刚刚放开师姐。
从院落之内走出。
林云有些回味的舔了舔嘴角。
更是把手放在鼻尖嗅了嗅。
淡淡的奶香味让他有些陶醉。
忽然。
林云微微眯了眯眼睛。
看向了天边的云海。
心中有一种预感。
凰凌天那个老家伙又出关了么。
但是应该没有这么快过来。
估计现在还在纠结呢。
林云对那个老不死的有些了解。
对方最是怕死了。
小心谨慎到变态的地步。
要是自己是他的话，近水楼台先得月。
早就想方设法把女皇给那什么了。
实在不行下药啊。

拖延到现在，反而快让对方成长到足够威胁自己了。
他听见自己突破的消息。
估计都快吓死了吧。
说不定还在想什么自己是他的劫数之类的莫名其妙的呢。
不过，凰曦儿对他而言，太重要了。
所以肯定不会轻易放弃。
自己就好整以暇等着他来就是了。
曾经他高高在上，对自己不屑一顾。
如今，自己让他高攀不起！
要是弄死了或者打残了他，这老不死的肯定会躲起来。
到时候，凰怜月，看看还有谁能保得住你。
也许，你可能在祈祷我们两败俱伤，你坐收渔翁之利。
但是你还是太天真了。
林云现在越是回想一些细节，也越是感觉不对劲。
总感觉自己被算计了。
用最简单的排除法，谁得利最大，谁是最终受益者。
谁就是主谋！
那么答案也呼之欲出。
那就是凰怜月那个可恶的女人！
但是让林云没想到的是，对方居然连自己名义上的凰女都丢出来当诱饵。

可真是最毒妇人心啊。
content_en:
And the other side.
Within the Yin Yang Holy Sect.
Lin Yuncai just let go of his senior sister.
Walk out of the courtyard.
Lin Yun licked the corner of his mouth with some aftertaste.
He even put his hand on the tip of his nose and sniffed.
The faint smell of milk made him a little intoxicated.
suddenly.
Lin Yun narrowed his eyes slightly.
He looked at the sea of ​​clouds on the horizon.
There was a premonition in my heart.
Is that old guy Huang Lingtian out of prison again?
But it shouldn't come so soon.
I guess I'm still confused now.
Lin Yun knew something about the old immortal.
The other party is most afraid of death.
Cautious to the point of perversion.
If he were him, he would get the moon first if he is near the water or the tower.
I have already tried every means to give the Queen to that.
I really can't take the medicine.
If you delay until now, the other party will soon grow enough to threaten you.
He heard the news of his breakthrough.
They were probably scared to death.
Maybe he was still thinking about some inexplicable thing like being his doom.
However, Huang Xi'er was too important to him.
So I won't give up easily.
Just wait for him to come.
He used to be aloof and dismissive of himself.
Now, he is so high that he cannot reach it!
If he was killed or maimed, the old immortal would definitely hide.
When the time comes, Huang Lianyue, let's see who else can protect you.
Perhaps, you may be praying that we will both lose and you will reap the benefits.
But you are still too naive.
The more Lin Yun thinks about some details now, the more he feels something is wrong.
I always feel like I'm being plotted.
Using the simplest elimination method, whoever benefits the most is the ultimate beneficiary.
Who is the mastermind!
Then the answer is ready to come out.
That is that hateful woman Huang Lianyue!
But what Lin Yun didn't expect was that the other party actually threw out his nominal Phoenix girl as bait.
This is the most poisonous woman's heart.
